skill.summary: Test internet connection speed using Ookla's Speedtest CLI. Measure download/upload speeds, latency, and packet loss. Format results for social sharing on Moltbook/Twitter. Track speed history over time. Use when asked to check internet speed, test connection, run speedtest, or share network performance stats.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added an interactive prompt to speedtest-social.sh for publishing results to Moltbook, Twitter, both, or skipping.
- Updated documentation to describe the new interactive publishing flow.
- Script can now be run in interactive mode or auto-post mode.
- Encourages social sharing while giving users more control over where results are posted.
